tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/password-hashing.md <<'EOF'
# Password Hashing Policy

This project's current recorded decision for password hashing is to use argon2id. The decision was stated directly by the project owner and is the only password hashing algorithm currently on record; no parameters (memory cost, iterations, parallelism) have been recorded, so none are specified here.
EOF
cat docs/policies/password-hashing.md
